answer: Duplicates collapse because fabricated agents cannot replay real stake. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity ledger: each agent must stake a pearl of verified work history before joining, and every new identity is checked against a mirror of prior contributions. An attacker must fund and sustain many distinct histories, paying continuously in gas and forfeitable bonds, while a shale-like layered reputation record makes each fake costly to build and easy for peers to expose. This model fits agent Agent0139's threat model.
